BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES.desc: Choose one: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, or heal 10% of it, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES_BLOC: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INHALE_SPICES_HEAL: Heal 10% of total [gold]Plague[/gold] on all enemies, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PANDEMIC.title: Pandemic
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PATIENT_ZERO.title: Patient Zero
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-PESTILENCE.title: Pestilence
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SEPTIC_CUT.title: Septic Cut
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CONTAMINATED_GAUZE:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to a random enemy.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-SYMPTOM_CHECK.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If any enemy has [gold]Plague[/gold], draw 1 card.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-FLEA_BITE.title: Flea Bite
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-FLEA_BITE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target already has [gold]Plague[/gold], apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MIASMA.title: Miasma
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-MIASMA.description: At the start of your turn, apply {PlaguePerTurn} [gold]Plague[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-ISOLATION_WARD.des: The first time each turn you apply [gold]Plague[/gold] to an enemy, gain {BlockOnPlague:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INCUBATION.title: Incubation
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-INCUBATION.descrip: Increase an enemy's [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent:diff()}%, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-CROSS_CONTAMINATIO: Apply {Percent:diff()}% of the target's [gold]Plague[/gold], rounded up, to every other enemy.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-TERMINAL_DIAGNOSIS:
Apply {Plague} [gold]Plague[/gold].
Then increase its [gold]Plague[/gold] by {Percent}%, rounded up.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-BLACK_TONIC.title: Black Tonic
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-BLACK_TONIC.descri:
Apply {SelfPlague} [gold]Plague[/gold] to yourself.
Gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold]. Unspent Energy persists into your next turn.
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-RELAPSE.title: Relapse
BRAD8381PLAGUEBRINGER-RELAPSE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, trigger [gold]Plague[/gold] on ALL enemies.
